text.title: CLAUDE.md Creation — Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps that produce the CLAUDE.md and its record in the order the rules bite: pick the template by layout, extract and run the commands, write the structure and key files, write repo-specific gotchas with env vars by name, split a monorepo root into per-app files, move personal content local, run the secret scan and hold the token budget, wire the manifest-resync check, then validate and commit. Each step names its rule and the template it fills.

step.name: pick-template-by-layout
step.input: The repository: one package or several apps with their own manifests.
step.action: Set `layout` single or monorepo and choose `template`: `templates/claude-md-minimal.md.j2` (250 tokens) for a single-language repo, `templates/claude-md-standard.md.j2` (500) for a product repo, `templates/claude-md-monorepo.md.j2` (700) for a monorepo root. Record the budget from the template header.
step.decision-gate: A monorepo takes the monorepo template; a single repo never takes it (r-token-budget-declared-and-held, r-monorepo-root-delegates-via-imports).

step.name: extract-and-run-commands
step.input: `package.json` scripts, `Makefile` targets, `pyproject.toml` tooling, `justfile`; a clean checkout.
step.action: Run `templates/extract-commands.sh` (or read the manifests) to list the commands, keep the ones a developer runs in the first hour, run each once on the clean checkout, and add a trailing comment saying what it does. Record each as `commands[]` with `source`, `comment`, `ran_ok`. Fill `## Commands`.
step.decision-gate: A command the author believes exists but did not run is fm-stale-commands and is not written (r-commands-extracted-and-executed).

step.name: write-structure-and-key-files
step.input: The directory tree; the files a developer needs in the first hour.
step.action: List at most 20 load-bearing paths with a one-phrase purpose each, excluding generated directories, as `structure[]`. Where a `## Key Files` table helps, list each file with purpose and confirm it exists at the stated path (`exists` true). Fill `## Structure` and `## Key Files`.
step.decision-gate: A `tree -L 3` paste or an entry without a purpose is fm-tree-dump-structure (r-structure-lists-load-bearing-paths-only).

step.name: write-gotchas-and-env-by-name
step.input: The incidents, lint rules, version pins and env vars that have cost a session before; `.env.example`.
step.action: Write each gotcha as trigger plus consequence naming a file, env var, command, version pin or lint rule (`names`). Reference env vars as `NAME=<required>` and point at `.env.example`; set `secrets_scan.env_vars_by_name_only` and `env_example_referenced` true. Fill `## Gotchas`.
step.decision-gate: "Write clean code" is fm-generic-advice-as-gotchas and is deleted (r-gotchas-are-repo-specific, r-zero-secrets-env-by-name-only).

step.name: delegate-per-app-in-monorepo
step.input: For a monorepo: each app directory and its manifests.
step.action: Keep only cross-cutting content in the root (workspace layout, shared packages, commands that run across all apps). Create a per-app `CLAUDE.md` next to each app with that app's commands and conventions, reference each by `@path` import or relative path, and confirm every referenced file exists. Record `monorepo.per_app_files[]` and `root_restates_app_commands` false. Fill `## Per-App Instructions`.
step.decision-gate: A root that restates `cd apps/api && make dev` duplicates what the per-app file owns; the two copies will diverge (r-monorepo-root-delegates-via-imports).

step.name: move-personal-content-local
step.action: Grep the draft for `/Users/`, `/home/`, `C:\` and personal handles; move machine paths, ports and personal preferences to `CLAUDE.local.md` (gitignored) or `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`. Record `local_settings.personal_paths_grep_clean` and `claude_local_md_gitignored`.
step.decision-gate: One developer's venv path in the shared file is fm-personal-paths-committed (r-personal-and-machine-specifics-stay-local).

step.name: scan-secrets-and-hold-budget
step.input: The draft; gitleaks, trufflehog or the host's scanner; a tokenizer.
step.action: Run the secret scanner over the file and record `secrets_scan.tool` and `clean`. Count tokens into `token_count`; if it exceeds the template budget, move narrative behind `@path` imports or one-line pointers until it fits — split, never trim the commands.
step.decision-gate: A pasted `.env` block is fm-secret-pasted-in: rotate first, then replace; a 3,000-token brief is fm-three-thousand-token-novel (r-zero-secrets-env-by-name-only, r-token-budget-declared-and-held).

step.name: wire-resync-check-validate-and-commit
step.input: CI or pre-commit; the filled record.
step.action: Add a check that fails when `package.json` scripts, `Makefile` targets or `pyproject.toml` tooling change without a CLAUDE.md `## Commands` edit, or when a listed command is no longer in the manifest; record `resync_check` and put its location in `evidence[]`. Run `scripts/validate-claude-md-creation.py --file <record.json>`; fix every violation; commit CLAUDE.md and the record.
step.output: A committed CLAUDE.md, its record, and a red build on the next silent rename.
step.decision-gate: Without the check the file drifts one renamed script at a time (r-commands-resync-on-manifest-change).

list.item: Every listed command ran with exit 0 on a clean checkout and the secret scan is clean.
The file is within its template's token budget and greps clean for personal paths.
The resync check is in CI or pre-commit and its location is in evidence[].
